## Change / Изменение

Describe the problem, the resulting wording or behavior, and the affected language or screens. English and Russian are welcome.

## Verification / Проверка

- [ ] `npm test` passed.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passed.
- [ ] Native fluency and bilingual accuracy were reviewed separately; reviewers and any agent use are identified below.
- [ ] Main screens were checked, or remaining interface checks are explicitly listed below.
- [ ] For RTL languages, a separate layout audit is included; otherwise mark this not applicable below.
- [ ] Generated artifacts were not edited by hand; original attribution is preserved.

List the actual commands and review evidence. For runtime changes, include targeted tests, type checking, a production build, and browser checks. For release artifacts, include reproducibility and forward/reverse checks. Mark checks that do not apply and explain any incomplete checks.

## Context / Контекст

Related issues, string keys, source ambiguities, compatibility changes, or redacted screenshots. Do not include credentials, real user content, or private deployment data.
